component-o.description-s: 1.5 uH ±30% wire-wound (ferrite) power inductor, 1210 (3.2 x 2.5 mm), DCR 0.057 Ohm ±20 % (68.4 mOhm max), rated current 1750 mA by inductance change and by 40 C temperature rise, SRF 70 MHz min

specs-o.isat_definition-s: rated current based on inductance change: L within ±30 % of nominal at rated current (note *1)

source-o.table-s: 3. Part Number and Rating, LQH32PN1R5NN0L: 1.5 uH, N ±30 %, DC resistance 0.057 Ohm ±20 %, SRF 70 MHz min, rated current 1750 mA (inductance change) / 1750 mA (temperature rise); notes *1-*3 on p2; operating -40..+85 C ambient (-40..+125 C product), storage -40..+125 C

specs-o.dcr_note-s: dcr_mohm = 57 mOhm x 1.2 (the stated +20 % tolerance) = 68.4 mOhm max
specs-o.ti_list_note-s: not in TI's TPS6303x recommended-inductor list (LPS3015, EPL3010, LQH3NP, NR3015 -- all 3 x 3 mm bodies, none 1210); chosen to fit the board's L_1210_3225Metric footprint at TI's 1.5 uH value

not_stated-o.isat_typ: Murata states a single rated current per criterion, no typ/max split
not_stated-o.height_mm: thickness not read (dimension drawing not parsed); DigiKey lists 1.70 mm max
